video_title: Cavs, Rockets, Mavs! BUILD It Up or BLOW It Up?!?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Cavaliers' need for roster changes
quotes.excerpt: they need some sort of change, they need some sort of turnover to be better in the postseason
quotes.quote: They could just stay put and probably be a top four team in the Eastern Conference and hope they're healthy and hit momentum in the playoffs, but they just don't have enough. They need some sort of change, they need some sort of turnover to be better in the postseason. They did that with James Harden and clearly that didn't work. They were a better team in the regular season, but then his postseason struggles continued. I love the dynamic duo of Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley, but I just feel like they got to get off something. Maybe get off Jared Allen and try and get something back, but they need other pieces.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins and Chandler Parsons debate the Cavaliers' roster strategy
quotes.excerpt: they need to get rid of one or two pieces and bring in some fresh blood

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I don't want them to blow it up, but they need to get rid of one or two pieces and bring in some fresh blood because clearly what they're doing is great regular season, but two of the main pieces, like two of the main four, because that to me that's a blow up. I think Jared Allen is the one to go.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Who's your who's your two? That's a big one. Okay.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: No, I think they keep Mobley, I think they keep Donovan Mitchell, but again, I think the core of this roster is good enough to get you a top five seed in the Eastern Conference. So I don't want them to blow it up, that'd be ridiculous.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the Cavaliers' progress and roster needs
quotes.excerpt: they do have to do some tweaking to their roster to figure out some specific roster moves
quotes.quote: I think they should continue to build it up. They made the conference finals for the first time since 2018, so that's something to be proud of. They had a good season regardless of how it ended in the conference finals. They lost to a really, really good Knicks team, but I don't think they're far off. They do have to do some tweaking to their roster to figure out some specific roster moves if it's moving Jared Allen, if it's sticking with James Harden moving forward, but I do like their core as far as Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley, so that's a good start. But figuring out those other two guys, I think that's the issue moving forward.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the Rockets' potential with young talent
quotes.excerpt: you got a lot of young pieces that you can build around and you can see the potential
quotes.quote: You continue to build. The season didn't go your way, but you got a lot of young pieces that you can build around and you can see the potential of what's next to come. I think they got a quality coach, I think they got a quality roster. You go out and Fred VanVleet will be back, so you'll shore up some of your point guard worries that they had this year. If you can go out and go get another dynamic scorer that's out there in free agency or in the trade market, you continue to build. But right now, if you're Houston, you don't love where you are, but you see where you can go, so you don't blow it up at this point, you definitely build it up.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Rockets' assets and roster outlook
quotes.excerpt: getting Fred back, getting Steven Adams back, being whole, I think this team will make a jump
quotes.quote: I agree. I think they have so much talent. They have two stars in Sengun and Kevin Durant and then Thompson's on the rise. I think getting Fred back, getting Steven Adams back, being whole, I think this team will make a jump and they have a lot of attractive assets that other teams would be interested in if they wanted to make a move. Tari Eason's free agency is going to be interesting, I think he'd be the one that they would kind of let walk, but I think this team has a lot of talent and they continue to build it up.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the Rockets' need for a scorer
quotes.excerpt: they also need to add another scorer. You got a guy like Jaylen Brown
quotes.quote: I do believe they also need to add another scorer. You got a guy like Jaylen Brown whose name is floating around right now in trade speculation. So with the way the Rockets are set up right now, they have a lot of assets, they have a lot of young players that could make that possibly make that situation a real thing. You connect Jaylen Brown with his former coach, and I think they have a good situation moving forward, but they do have the core to continue to move forward. I think it's just about making those pieces complement one another and I think the biggest thing is getting Fred VanVleet back.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the Mavericks' rebuilding process
quotes.excerpt: just continue the process, continue to develop the young talent, continue to fill the team with other young assets
quotes.quote: They're already in the midst of their blow up. Just continue the process, continue to develop the young talent, continue to fill the team with other young assets. They got a good coach coming in as far as what he's done on the collegiate level. We'll see what happens at the pro level, but everything is moving forward the way it should for this group. So just continue on the path they're on right now.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Mavericks' need for patience
quotes.excerpt: they just need to be patient. They weren't patient with the Luka, they weren't patient with the Anthony Davis
quotes.quote: They have Cooper Flagg, they have their guy going forward, so whatever they do, if they blow it up, they're going to blow it up with him being built around, you know what I mean? So and I don't think they do that. I think this need to be patient. They weren't patient with the Luka, they weren't patient with the Anthony Davis. There's no reason to. Let's see what kind of version we get of Kyrie Irving. Let's see what, you know, PJ and Gafford and Clay Thompson. I wouldn't early just to see like what he's like I think I think he could be very very good.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins and Chandler Parsons on Kyrie Irving's role in Dallas
quotes.excerpt: they're on two different timelines. We're talking about a 19-year-old rookie and a 32-0 33-year-old guy

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I wouldn't early just to see like what he's like I think I think he could be very very good.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: You take the call and just don't proactively go out.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: They're on two different timelines. We're talking about a 19-year-old rookie and a 32-0 33-year-old guy that's, you know, I think he's still a very good player, but he's towards the end of his career. The timelines don't match up and you can still get some value back as far as, you know, moving off of Kyrie right now. So it only makes sense for them to.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Mavericks' roster limitations
quotes.excerpt: this existing roster is not good enough to compete
quotes.quote: And this existing roster is not good enough to compete, but they do like guys like Lively, Gafford, Clay Thompson, PJ Washington, like those are good assets, they would be closer to a blow up than to build up, but regardless they have Cooper Flagg to do either or.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Kyrie Irving's mentorship in Dallas
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie is in his mentor bag. You see what he's doing with the youth
quotes.quote: Kyrie is in his mentor bag. You see what he's doing with the youth. You got a 19-year-old that can use your your your experiences and can use you as a point guard to help him win some basketball games. That's the only thing that's attractive to me in Kyrie standing in Dallas, but you got I agree with you guys, you have the assets to go out there and shop some guys around to bring back in a a a a big load of guys that can help you whoa a a a a a hall of guys that can help you win a lot of basketball games. But when it comes to Kyrie Irving and his mentoring, I think he can help Cooper Flagg.
